verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs say it reviews the full codebase, not just the diff (qodo-docs-22), and catches breaking changes that diff-only tools miss (qodo-docs-60). Cross-repo and service relationships inform change impact (qodo-docs-14, qodo-docs-25), and existing conventions are covered through centralized rules, Rule Miner and PR-history learning (qodo-docs-12, qodo-docs-13, qodo-docs-48). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of call-site and cross-module analysis inside individual review comments (the full-codebase claim is stated for the PR summary), and independent or hands-on corroboration of codebase-aware review quality.
